g.text: The 90th percentile (Rs 660,000) is 6.88 times the 10th percentile (Rs 96,000)
Half of urban Punjab's earners make less than Rs 240,000 a year
Source: PSLM 2019-20 person file. Sample: 3,768 earners (ages 15-64, annual earnings > 0) in urban Punjab.
All statistics weighted by hhweight. 25 earners outside Rs 10,000 to Rs 10,000,000 are excluded from the histogram (20 below, 5 above).
